description: This file contains validation functions for Kubernetes scheduling API objects, including PriorityClass, Workload, PodGroup, and related references, ensuring correctness and immutability constraints.

methods.name: ValidatePriorityClass
methods.description: Validates the fields of a PriorityClass object, including name prefix, value, and preemption policy.

methods.name: ValidatePriorityClassUpdate
methods.description: Validates updates to PriorityClass, ensuring immutability of name, value, and preemption policy.

methods.name: ValidateWorkload
methods.description: Validates a Workload object, including metadata and workload-specific fields.

methods.name: ValidateWorkloadUpdate
methods.description: Validates updates to a Workload, including immutability constraints.
